name: MineLimit | We're back, and better than ever.
description:
Server IP: play.coffeeverse.org

Version: 1.8 - 26.*

Discord: https://discord.gg/BupJrVytXe

Step into CoffeeVerse, a premium Minecraft network built around a cozy coffee aesthetic and smooth, modern gameplay. Pick your path: head into Survival to explore, build and thrive in a fresh world, or start from a single block in Skyblock and grow your own island empire. Both modes run on a fast, lag-free setup, and you can hop between them anytime from the lobby.

Key Features:

Two Game Modes: Survival and Skyblock, each with custom plugins made for a smooth progression.

Player-Driven Economy: Open your own shop, trade with other players and climb the wealth leaderboards.

Custom Quests & Events: Ongoing progression and regular events that keep every session rewarding.

Cross-Version Support: Join from any client version between 1.8 and 26.* thanks to ViaVersion and ViaBackwards.

Friendly Community: An active, fair and welcoming staff team that’s always around to help on our Discord.

Grab your coffee, pick your mode, and start your journey today.
